map_features.note: Japanese coastal-branch reference corridor from an OSW eastern Tsushima Strait approach to a western Tsugaru Strait approach. Excludes the offshore/Korean branch, Soya continuation and the separately named Tsugaru outflow. Connecting vertices do not assert uninterrupted flow or a full-system length. Downstream merges are shared circulation context, not exclusive nearshore water-parcel continuity.
map_features.spatial_geometry_method: WGS84 geodesic legs densified at <=10 km as in the existing reference-route state join; planar relation to coarse masked OSW display polygons.

widths.boundary_rule: Offshore modal amplitude exp(-gamma_1*y), relative to its coastal value; adopted exp(-3) decay criterion (approximately 5%). Printed gamma_1=1.3e-4 m^-1.
widths.extraction_method: Manual original equation and context transcription with visual verification; independently calculate printed arithmetic, without digitizing current boundaries.
widths.geographic_scope: Nearshore branch over the continental shelf off the San’in coast, Japan Sea; not the entire Tsushima Current system.
widths.layer: First baroclinic mode under summer density stratification; eastward above the seasonal thermocline and westward below. No fixed width slab extracted.

modal_decay_context.coefficient_method: Separation constant of density-profile eigenvalue problem (Eq7 with boundary conditions); least-squares fits current data to computed mode shapes, not an offshore velocity-coefficient fit.

common_current_mean_period.source_locator: Printed p159, section4: common period for five-station time averages.

modal_decay_context.display_caption: Coastal branch · reported modal width 22 km (summer 1980). Diagram illustrates the published exponential expression; its differential-equation sign remains unresolved. No mapped edge or seasonal range.
modal_decay_context.display_method_note: The source adopts roughly 5% of coastal amplitude as the edge. Its printed coefficient gives 23.1 km; the paper reports 22 km and summarizes about 20 km. Arithmetic discrepancy unresolved; numerical uncertainty unknown.

hydrographic_profile_support.role: Density profile input for computed vertical modes; not a current edge.

model_assumptions: Zero initial potential vorticity; coast-relative exponential offshore mode

offshore_equation_consistency.source_locator: Printed p161 / PDF page 6, Eq8 and following solution statement; original visually verified.

station_B_modal_mean_period.source_locator: Printed p162, Figure8 discussion: entire B record.

widths.name: Tsushima Current
widths.range_interpretation: Reported 22 km; summary approximately 20 km and recalculation 23.0769 km describe the same estimate. They do not define a measured range or numerical uncertainty.
remaining_gates: Resolve source differential-equation sign and arithmetic discrepancies; independent scientific admission.
Extract geographically located compatible boundaries and uncertainty.

widths.section_orientation: Offshore y direction approximately northward from the east–west coast in the source model; paired edge coordinates unresolved.
widths.source_citation: Matsuyama, M. (1990), The Structure of the Nearshore Branch of the Tsushima Current on the Shelf off the San’in Coast in Summer, Journal of the Oceanographical Society of Japan 46(4):156–166, doi:10.1007/BF02125576.
widths.source_locator: Printed p165 / PDF page 10, Discussion decay equation and Summary(1); eigenvalue and fit method p161 / PDF page 6; station dates p158 and common average p159; separate Fig10 p164.
widths.source_quality_note: Reported 22 km disagrees with 3/(1.3e-4) m = 23.0769 km; cause unresolved. Approximately 20 km is a summary of the same estimate. Fig10 caption 134°E conflicts with Discussion 132°E; the climatological section is separate support. Printed Eq8 plus sign is inconsistent with the stated exponential solution for real positive gamma; no correction inferred.
widths.time_convention: Finite July–August 1980 campaign. Modal coefficient from the 8 August hydrographic profile; station and current-average durations differ. No homogeneous width occupation interval or recurring seasonal calendar assigned.
